correctness.rationale: The exact hypergeometric transition and inclusion-exclusion for M_{t-1}=b give the displayed joint law; conditional terminal hit is (s)_b/(n)_b. Embedded strictly decreasing missing-count chain gives exact 2->0 rate (s-1)/(2n-s-1) and summable skip/large-jump bounds; for s/n->0 they yield relative O(s/n). Bulk exact factorial moments of unseen counts converge to phase-indexed Poisson and hypergeometric thinning yields the marked joint pmf. Its mass telescopes over j∈Z, so pointwise convergence yields total variation. Independent rational DP versus inclusion-exclusion for n<=8, s<n, t<=5 confirms finite identities, not the asymptotic proof.
